description: Permanent archive of all EEG embedding experiments, benchmarks, and fine-tuning results produced during T-030, T-031, Mission 4, and the 50-subject validation cycle. This is a read-only historical record — no values are invented; all metrics are sourced from the actual benchmark JSON outputs and report files.

bugs_and_corrections.description: Test embeddings were included in the retrieval pool alongside training embeddings, inflating recall@K scores for all models (disproportionately for PCA).
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Changed from test+train pool mixing to train-only candidate pools. Self-retrieval exclusion applied per-query.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: Recall@K values for all models were inflated before fix; PCA advantage was artificially widened.
bugs_and_corrections.original_result: Not available / not recorded (estimated ~0.42 recall@1 for PCA)

bugs_and_corrections.description: Used Math.random() for power-iteration start vectors (non-deterministic) and incorrect deflation formula: cov[i][j] -= v[i]*v[j]*cov[i][j] instead of correct A[i][j] -= lambda * v[i] * v[j].
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Replaced with production fitPCA/transformPCA (seeded power iteration, seed: 0x2026_0711).
bugs_and_corrections.impact: The 'PCA baseline' was not actually PCA but a random projection that incidentally denoised high-dimensional model embeddings, making PCA appear artificially effective.
bugs_and_corrections.original_result: PCA bandpower baseline with buggy reduction
bugs_and_corrections.corrected_result: PCA bandpower baseline with correct seeded PCA

bugs_and_corrections.bug_name: PCA applied to model embeddings instead of bandpower features
bugs_and_corrections.description: Old pcaBaselineRecall applied PCA dimensionality reduction to model's OWN embeddings, not the PCA bandpower feature pipeline. Not a fair baseline comparison.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: PCA baseline now uses production embedSignal (bandpower features → PCA(32) → L2-normalize).
bugs_and_corrections.impact: Before fix: PCA appeared to denoise model outputs (curse of dimensionality benefit). After fix: PCA is a proper feature-based baseline.

bugs_and_corrections.description: FEMBA-tiny outputs [B, 80, 385] and CBraMod outputs [B, 19, 5, 200], but old code used raw output without mean-pooling, breaking nearest-centroid classification.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Added outputPooling: 'mean-tokens' to FEMBA-tiny and CBRaMod registry entries. applyOutputPooling() collapses token grids to embeddingDim.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: FEMBA-tiny and CBraMod went from garbage accuracy to valid 200-dim (CBraMod) and 385-dim (FEMBA) embeddings.

bugs_and_corrections.description: FEMBA-tiny embeddingDim was 30800 (should be 385), CBraMod was 19000 (should be 200), LaBraM was 768 (should be 200) with windowSamples 200 (should be 1600).
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Corrected all dimension specs in registry.ts and benchmark.ts.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: Models produced wrong-dimension embeddings, breaking the retrieval pipeline.

bugs_and_corrections.description: ONNX adapter used hardcoded 2-second window (500 samples at 250 Hz), but EEGConformer was trained on 4-second windows (1000 samples). Wrong-length inputs caused silent PCA fallback.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Replaced firstWindowFromInput with selectRawWindow: resolution order (1) exact-match window, (2) first window with right channels and sufficient length, (3) longest signal window, (4) mean-pool across matching windows. Production upload.ts now passes segment: { windowSec: 4, overlap: 0.5 }.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: EEGConformer was receiving 500-sample windows instead of 1000, silently degrading to PCA fallback.
bugs_and_corrections.original_result: EEGConformer accuracy ~0.253 (on 500-sample windows, possibly via PCA fallback)

bugs_and_corrections.description: Ternary expression '0 if event_type == T1 else 1 if run_idx == 0 else (2 if event_type == T1 else 3)' mislabeled ALL Run 6 T1 (feet) events as class 0 instead of class 2. This is because the ternary evaluates event_type == T1 first (always true for T1 events), never reaching the run_idx == 0 branch.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Replaced ternary with explicit if/else block matching benchmark_tier4.py's correct implementation.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: Inflated results for models with poor feet-left-hand discrimination. LaBraM +10%, CBraMod +3.3%, EEGPT +5.3%, FEMBA-tiny +13% relative inflation.
bugs_and_corrections.original_result: Inflated accuracy across affected models (exact original values not all recorded)

bugs_and_corrections.description: Training pipeline used Math.random() for weight initialization, sample shuffling, and data augmentation noise, preventing reproducible comparison.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Added mulberry32 seeded PRNG (TRAINING_SEED = 20260617). Replaced all Math.random() calls with rng().
bugs_and_corrections.impact: Training results were non-reproducible; fixed seed ensures deterministic training.

bugs_and_corrections.description: Runtime preprocessing used bandpass 1-40 Hz while training config specified 4-38 Hz. EEGConformer was trained on 4-38 Hz but runtime fed it differently-filtered signals.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: Changed training pipeline bandpass from {low:1, high:40} to {low:4, high:38}. Production upload.ts uses 4-38 Hz bandpass in preprocess() call.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: Runtime embeddings were extracted from differently-filtered signals than training, degrading model performance.

bugs_and_corrections.bug_name: Curse of dimensionality in cosine similarity
bugs_and_corrections.description: For high-dimensional embeddings (EEGPT: 2048-dim, LaBraM: 200-dim), cosine similarity becomes less discriminative — all vectors cluster near the same cosine distance.
bugs_and_corrections.fix: This is a fundamental mathematical property, not a code bug. The 32-dimensional PCA bandpower features avoid this issue. No code fix applied.
bugs_and_corrections.impact: High-dimensional model embeddings suffered in similarity search, giving PCA an unfair advantage in the old benchmark.
bugs_and_corrections.status: documented finding (not a code bug, no fix needed)
